summary.text: Royce West, a Democratic attorney from Dallas, has represented Texas Senate District 23 since 1993 after being first elected in 1992. He is vice chair of the Senate Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: West holds B.A. and M.A. degrees from the University of Texas at Arlington and a J.D. from the University of Houston, and has been a member of the State Bar of Texas since 1979.
He is managing partner of West & Associates, L.L.P.

His official profile credits him with the establishment of the University of North Texas at Dallas and its College of Law, and with passing Texas' first racial profiling bill and first body camera law.
He is married to Carol R. West and is a member of Concord Church Dallas.
